title: Elegant looking spoons but not good with grapefruit.
text: Elegant looking spoons but not good with grapefruit.. The spoons are very well made, sturdy and beautiful.  They would be great for a nice table setting.  However, the edges are not sharp enough to cut through grapefruit without multiple attempts.  They are usable, but just barely.
